evidence_sentence: It notifies observers of the new download creation and calls the OnDownloadStarted function with the download item and the provided callback.
rationale: The fixed implementation adds an `if (download)` guard around observer notification and `OnNewDownloadCreated`, whereas the vulnerable implementation notifies observers unconditionally even when `CreateActiveItem` returns null. The quoted sentence unconditionally specifies observer notification, thereby matching the vulnerable-only behavior. Calling `OnDownloadStarted` remains outside the guard in both versions.
rewritten_docstring: The function checks that it is called on the UI thread, creates an active download item, and invokes the provided callback with the new download item. It processes the new download creation and calls the OnDownloadStarted function with the download item and the provided callback.
